system.description:
The independent circle of Mournas, outside the Cabal, and the hedge-druids of Opal's gardens: the wild that lives in walls, gutters and gardens.

  • Reshapes: Beast Kin (the beasts of a town).
  • Urban Swarm: once each round, one creature that takes damage from your spell or fails a save against it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll, as rats, birds and insects mob it. It works wherever such creatures can reach: not in the open sea, bare ice or a sealed vault. The rats, dogs and birds of a town count as natural beasts for Beast Kin.
    • 9th level: the swarm also halves the creature's speed until the end of its next turn.
  • City's Wild: Advantage on checks to find shelter, safe passage or allies in a city through its wild things: the rats in the walls, the moss on the stones, the gardens between buildings.
